headline: Master Peyton Drops 175 and Stays Perfect
dek: Week 2 split the EFL into three 2-0 teams and three 0-2 teams as Master Peyton led all scoring with 175.24, The Duke survived the week’s tightest finish, and the power board shuffled at Nos. 4-5 and 8-9.

lead.title: Master Peyton Owns the Week — and the Top of the Table
lead.body: Master Peyton delivered the EFL’s biggest Week 2 number, beating Kaaron Rodgers 175.24–135.28 to move to 2-0 with a league-high 335.40 points through two weeks. The Don’s Soldiers also stayed perfect with a 169.88–90.98 win over Mach Chicken, while Blaze Infantry improved to 2-0 by beating KamaraVirus125177 153.82–64.60. That leaves Master Peyton, The Don’s Soldiers and Blaze Infantry as the league’s three unbeaten franchises, with Trash Pandas, KamaraVirus125177 and bonebuster at 0-2. The refreshed EFL power board keeps Master Peyton No. 1 at 90.7, followed by The Don’s Soldiers at 82.7 and Kaaron Rodgers at 80.9.

briefs.label: PHOTO FINISH
briefs.title: The Duke Holds Off Trash Pandas by 4.78
briefs.body: The closest matchup of Week 2 went to The Duke, which edged Trash Pandas 116.46–111.68. The 4.78-point escape moved The Duke to 1-1 and left Trash Pandas at 0-2 after two competitive weeks.

briefs.label: POWER BOARD
briefs.title: The Duke and Landshark Climb
briefs.body: The top three remain unchanged, but the middle shifted after Week 2. The Duke rises one spot to No. 4 at 76.5, Blaze Infantry slips one to No. 5 at 76.4, LandsharkSC moves up to No. 8 at 70.9, and BigKipper74 falls to No. 9 at 66.9.

briefs.label: SCORING DESK
briefs.title: League Scoring Cools, but the Ceiling Jumps
briefs.body: Week 2 scoring averaged 112.35 points per franchise, down 7.33 from the 119.68 Week 1 average. Even with the dip, Master Peyton (175.24), The Don’s Soldiers (169.88) and Blaze Infantry (153.82) all cleared 150, while 28Wizardking, KamaraVirus125177 and bonebuster each finished below 70.

briefs.label: TRANSACTION WIRE
briefs.title: Waiver Bids Lead a Trade-Free Week
briefs.body: Sleeper shows no completed trade in the Week 2 or early Week 3 transaction buckets. The largest listed Week 2 bid was Trash Pandas’ $8 add of Kendrick Bourne; bonebuster paid $5 for Raheim Sanders after dropping Ray Davis, and BigKipper74 spent $5 on Demond Claiborne plus $1 to add Ray Davis. Mach Chicken later added Kyle Williams for $1 and Keenan Allen for $0.
